summary: Thinking Machines' Tinker pricing page lists a free tier for Inkling 2 Mini (MoE, 26.4B total, 5.4B active parameters), released Nov 20, 2026 with open weights. The free tier costs $0.00 per 1M tokens for prefill, cached prefill, sampling and training, is limited to 64K context, and is subject to rate limits; requests may be throttled when limits are reached. Prepaid accounts must have a positive balance to use the free tier. The paid Inkling 2 Mini tiers (64K and 256K context) remain available. No end date is stated.
claim_steps: Sign in to Tinker; a prepaid account must have a positive balance to use the free tier
Train and sample within the 64K context limit; requests may be throttled at rate limits

social_proof.title: Tinker Pricing - Thinking Machines Lab
social_proof.text: Inkling 2 Mini (free), 64K: $0.00 prefill, $0.00 cached prefill, $0.00 sample, $0.00 train. To use the free tier, select the model ID thinkingmachines/Inkling-2-Mini:peft:65536:free. Free training and sampling have a 64K context limit and are subject to rate limits. Requests may be throttled when those limits are reached. Prepaid accounts must have a positive balance to use the free tier.
